initialBuild.title: Mining Active / AFK (Barb) 50+
initialBuild.description:
## Rage_Basics

Place points into Brute Efficiency, and then Idle Skilling.
*1 Excess points can be placed into STR.

## Warrior

Place 1 point into Firmly Grasp It. Then place points into "Big Pick". Afterwards, equally upgrade Motherlode Miner and Copper Collector.

## Barbarian

Max Back to Basics.
*1 Excess points go into Strongest Statues.
